Graduate Mechanical Engineer · Georgia Tech & EPF

Structural analysis and design, in the service of science and industry.

Dual-degree mechanical engineer trained in France and the United States, I place technical rigour at the service of knowledge and the collective good. A generalist foundation exposed me to the many horizons of engineering before I specialised in materials mechanics and structural analysis. At ease in international, multicultural environments — I work in four languages — I bring deep mechanical expertise backed by a broad engineering culture to complex problems.

PROJ-01 · System design · 2024

Terrestrial vehicle design

  • Led the system-level development of an ultra-compact vehicle architecture, presenting engineering decisions during technical design reviews.
  • Designed 3D models of the tubular chassis and other compact mechanical assemblies in CATIA V5.
  • Performed FEA on the dimensioned chassis to validate its behaviour under low-speed shocks (<15 km/h).
  • Modelled the full vehicle — driver, controller, battery, motor, gears and body — in Amesim to simulate suspension behaviour and acceleration performance.
  • Ensured full compliance with project specifications through technical documentation packages (design justification and FEA computation reports).

Ranked 1st of 12 teams — Best Vehicle Design

  • Amesim
  • FEA

PROJ-02 · Structural analysis · 2024

Deployable bridge structural analysis

Designed an armoured vehicle-launched bridge in CATIA V5 and optimised it through iterative FEA. Surface modelling and modal analysis in ABAQUS validated the first natural frequency against the military requirement specification.

Final mass 18% below specification

PROJ-03 · Actuation · 2023

Maestro robotic arm actuators

Dimensioned four rotary hydraulic actuators for the articulated joints of a teleoperated arm used in nuclear decommissioning. Material choices were validated through coupled thermal–structural analysis in COMSOL Multiphysics, assessing both stress distribution and heat conduction.

  • COMSOL
